course_position.stage_name: Toward B1 - Complex Conversations and Narratives

lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice using skulle for reported future plans.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Checking whether a colleague is still coming to lunch, fika, or a social plan.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Reporting a plan that someone mentioned earlier.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik coordinate a lunch or after-work plan and mention what another colleague said earlier.

main_focus.name: reported future with skulle
main_focus.description: Use skulle in an att-clause to report a planned future action from an earlier conversation.
model_examples: Hon sa att hon skulle komma lite senare.
Han sa att han skulle äta lunch med oss.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use reported future with skulle naturally 2-3 times.

useful_chunks: Hon sa att hon skulle komma senare.
vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use practical planning chunks and keep the reported future meaning clear.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker asks whether the plan is still happening.
dialogue_shape.middle: They report earlier messages or comments using skulle.
dialogue_shape.ending: They adjust the plan or decide to wait.

target_complexity.repetition: repeat the reported future pattern with small variations

focus: what earlier message or information changes the timing
what decision is made about waiting or adjusting

sentence_focus: one sentence with sa att plus skulle
one sentence about receiving a text message
one sentence asking whether to wait
one sentence combining a changed plan and a decision
